name: GS Retail Co., Ltd.
summary: GS Retail Co., Ltd. is a prominent South Korean enterprise primarily involved in the retail sector. Its diverse portfolio includes the widespread GS25 convenience store chain, a network of GS Supermarket outlets, Watsons health and beauty stores, and the Parnas hotel brand. Established in 1971, the company maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea. Furthermore, it functions as a subsidiary of GS Holdings Corp.
